missions.title: Post the SBS News story of Bender the Melbourne cat with one personal line on why a real famous cat is different.
Post the cat's reach next to the market cap and ask what it means that this exact cat is inscribed on Solana. Personal angle mandatory.
Reply to 3 non-holder posts about Solana meme history with a genuine take and the decoder link. Value first, link last.

days.ritual: Top 3 quality replies pinned on X at 9 PM ET.

days.theme: The picture is in the block

missions.title: Ship a 15 to 30 second video: the real cat, then the explorer, then the base64 URI, then the decoded JPEG. Use Script 1 in the Content Kit.
Screenshot the base64 metadata on Explorer and post your read on why this beats an image pointing at IPFS.
Tag one friend who needs to see the decoder, with a line about why you sent it to them.

days.ritual: Best video of the day reshared by the official account at 9 PM ET.

missions.title: Post the vault numbers in your own words: 420,690,000 to claim, 43.83 percent of supply, no admin, no upgrade key, hash published.
Run a poll: would you lock 43.83 percent of supply for the 1 of 1 deed? Add your own reasoning.
Screen record 30 seconds walking the vault program on Solscan and post it with one line of commentary.

days.ritual: Clearest vault explainer of the day gets pinned at 9 PM ET.

missions.title: First Instagram post: the launch carousel from the Content Kit. Real cat, then the inscription, then SOL landing in a wallet.
Post your own rewards receipt: screenshot of SOL received plus your balance, with the twenty dollar floor fact.
Explain the tier system in plain words: the rate is set by market cap, it moves both ways, and pump.fun publishes the whole table.

days.ritual: Instagram launch celebrated in TG, best carousel pinned at 9 PM ET.

missions.title: Play the game and post your high score screenshot with a one line honest review.
Invite one non-holder friend to play. It costs nothing and needs no wallet. Post their score or reaction.
Make a meme with the meme maker on this page and post it with your own caption.

days.ritual: Best meme of the day reshared at 9 PM ET.

missions.title: Post your personal takeover story: when you found the coin and why you stayed after the deployer left.
Post what a coordinated 237 person room can do, without promising anything about price.
Answer one takeover skeptic with the proof kit: deployer wallet holds zero, all authorities revoked, source published, hash matches.

days.ritual: Best story of the day read at the 9 PM ET ceremony.

missions.title: Post your best of week collage: your own top posts from the seven days.
Post a personal reflection: what the week proved to you.
Show up at the closing ceremony at 9 PM ET. Season 2 drops at the ceremony, before the applause dies.

days.ritual: Closing ceremony 9 PM ET: honest week numbers, champions named, Season 2 revealed.

scoring.streak_rule: Complete a mission on 4 of the 7 days and your week total earns a 1.5x multiplier.
